android.desc:
Looking to cut your weekly food shop bill? Compare grocery prices across all major UK supermarkets with Grocery Compare - the ultimate UK grocery price tracker and grocery price comparison tool. 

Search any product and instantly find the cheapest supermarket for your grocery shopping. Compare real-time prices across Aldi, Tesco, Sainsbury's, Asda, Morrisons, Waitrose, Iceland, Lidl, Ocado, M&S, and Co-op.

True Loyalty Card Pricing
Never get caught out at the till. We automatically include Tesco Clubcard prices and Sainsbury’s Nectar prices.


KEY FEATURES
Compare 10+ UK Supermarkets: Instant price comparison across every major UK grocery retailer and food shop.

Sort by Unit Price (PPU): Find true value by sorting products by cheapest price per unit (per 100g, per kg, per litre) or total item price.

Member Prices Included: Full integration of Tesco Clubcard, Sainsbury's Nectar Card, and supermarket loyalty discount pricing.

Filter by Supermarket Store: Quickly filter results to compare only the supermarkets near you (e.g., Tesco vs Aldi, Asda vs Sainsbury's).

Category Search: Search is built from the ground-up for relevancy, no more sorting by lowest price and have "olive oil" return canned tuna in olive oil.

Smart Shopping List & Price Calculator: Build your weekly shopping list and calculate store price totals before leaving the house.

WHY CHOOSE US OVER OTHER GROCERY APPS?
Unlike traditional price checkers, Grocery Compare is built specifically for true value shoppers:

True Unit Price Sorting: Compare items by price per unit (£/100g, £/100ml) across different brand sizes to find the genuine cheapest deal.

Relevant Search Results: No random product clutter — only direct, relevant supermarket product matches.

Clean & Fast Interface: Check supermarket prices in seconds while walking down the aisle.

COMING SOON
Cheapest Basket Compare: Add your full weekly grocery list and discover which supermarket is cheapest overall for your entire shop.

More UK Retailers: Adding B&M, Poundland, Home Bargains.

Barcode Price Scanner: Scan items in-store to instantly compare prices at competing supermarkets.

quotes.text:
I'm a first year CS student at Sheffield and built this over the past year because I thought I could do better than Trolley.

Stack: React Native & Typesense for vector search and filtering. An ETL pipeline runs in the background handling scraping and automatic product categorisation using embeddings.

Covers Aldi, Tesco, Sainsbury's, Asda, Morrisons, Waitrose, Iceland, Ocado / M&S and Co-op. Clubcard and Nectar prices included. Sort by price per unit, filter by category and stores near you.

This was fun to make, and I have a lot planned, with some WIP:

- Basket Generation based on entering a shopping list and getting cheapest products for each store, and cheapest collection of stores for the cheapest total shop. Feels quite magical even in dev mode right now

- Local price estimates. Local stores differ from online prices by up to 20% depending on store fascia. I'm thinking to record a basket of goods for each local store and use it to estimate local prices

- Crowdsourced prices. Tricky one, due to running from a cold start. Would be very useful for certain stores without online prices, eg. Lidl.

That's all for now! Hopefully it'll help me get an internship even without traction ^_^
